## Change

Describe what changed and why.

## Risk

Describe security, privacy, AI/model, Android/device, infrastructure, release/signing, data, or compatibility risk. Write `None identified` when appropriate.

## Verification

Provide reproducible evidence for the exact commit under review.

- [ ] Tests or validation commands completed
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, signing material, or private data added
- [ ] Security-sensitive behavior was not weakened merely to make checks pass
- [ ] New third-party dependencies or actions are pinned/reviewed where applicable
- [ ] Documentation was updated when behavior or operations changed

## Release / rollback

Describe release impact and rollback path when applicable.
